sections.text:
Sudden alteration of mood. Foxy. De-
structive impulses; moral relaxation. Must constantly
busy herself or walk.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
^ — Intense pain, as if thousands of needles were
pricking into brain. Vertigo. [Granatum.]

sections.label: Male
sections.text:
Sexual excitement ; lasciviousness reaching
almost to insanity; seminal emissions.

sections.label: Heart
sections.text:
Palpitation ; praecordial anguish, sensation as
if heart twisted and turned around.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Vulva dry and hot, with much itching.
Profuse menstruation, with frequent erotic spasms.
Pruritus vuh'cu; nymphomania. Dysmenorrhcea, with
very sensitive ovaries.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Weakness of legs; choreic movements.
Numbness of legs. Multiple sclerosis, with trembling.
Tivitching and jerking.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
IVorse, motion, contact, noise. Bette* ^
in open air, music, bright colors, rubbing affected parts.
IVorse, seeing others in trouble.
